columns.name: LOG_NO
columns.description: A unique identifier for the case record. The log number can be used to link records in other datasets that contain a log number column.

columns.name: COMPLAINT_DATE
columns.description: The date that the complaint or notification was made to IPRA/COPA and the record was created.

columns.name: ASSIGNMENT
columns.description: The jurisdictional assignment for the complaint case.

columns.name: CASE_TYPE
columns.description: Whether a case is a complaint, a notification, or miscellaneous.

columns.name: CURRENT_STATUS
columns.description: The current status of the case investigation, as of the date the data were last published.

columns.name: CURRENT_CATEGORY
columns.description: The category of the primary allegation against the involved CPD member.

columns.name: FINDING_CODE
columns.description:
The overall current case finding, ranked by the following hierarchy: Sustained, Not Sustained, Unfounded, Exonerated, No Affidavit, and No Finding.

“Current_Finding” means that even after COPA has completed an investigation and made a recommended finding, the finding can change given post-COPA processes, including Police Department review, Police Board adjudication, and grievance and arbitration processes.

columns.name: POLICE_SHOOTING
columns.description: Whether or not the case is a police shooting.

columns.name: BEAT
columns.description: The CPD beat in which the incident occurred. If more than one beat was involved, the values are separated by the pipe (|) character.

columns.name: RACE_OF_COMPLAINANTS
columns.description: The race or ethnicity of the complainant(s) or subject(s). If more than one person was involved, the values are separated by the pipe (|) character and in the same order for all columns.

columns.name: SEX_OF_COMPLAINANTS
columns.description: The sex of the complainant(s) or subject(s). If more than one person was involved, the values are separated by the pipe (|) character and in the same order for all columns.

columns.name: AGE_OF_COMPLAINANTS
columns.description: The age of the complainant(s) or subject(s). If more than one person was involved, the values are separated by the pipe (|) character and in the same order for all columns.

columns.name: RACE_OF_INVOLVED_OFFICERS
columns.description: The race or ethnicity of the officer alleged to have been involved. If more than one officer allegedly was involved, the values are separated by the pipe (|) character and in the same order for all officer columns.

columns.name: SEX_OF_INVOLVED_OFFICERS
columns.description: The sex of the officer alleged to have been involved. If more than one officer allegedly was involved, the values are separated by the pipe (|) character and in the same order for all officer columns

columns.name: AGE_OF_INVOLVED_OFFICERS
columns.description: The age of the officer alleged to have been involved at the time of the complaint or notification. If more than one officer allegedly was involved, the values are separated by the pipe (|) character and in the same order for all officer columns

columns.name: YEARS_ON_FORCE_OF_INVOLVED_OFFICERS
columns.description: The number of years on the force of the officer alleged to have been involved at the time of the complaint or notification. If more than one officer allegedly was involved, the values are separated by the pipe (|) character and in the same order for all officer columns

columns.name: COMPLAINT_HOUR
columns.description: The hour of the day component of COMPLAINT_DATE.

columns.name: COMPLAINT_DAY
columns.description: The day of the week component of COMPLAINT_DATE. Sunday=1
